site: www.diners.co.jp (Diners Club Japan / Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Club)
platform: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM Sites) with WCM Core Components (cmp-*) plus custom 'CCM###_*' components (e.g. CCM005_Html, CCM006_Text, CCM008_List, CCM001_Grid, CCM009_Button, CCM013_Breadcrumb, CCM020_CarouselBanner, CCM027_2ndLevelMenu). Header/footer delivered as AEM Experience Fragments. Some sections (benefit, magazine, event, press) use older custom JSP/Sightly templates with bespoke markup rather than Core Components.
inspectionNote: The browser session was intermittently hijacked to www.sumitclub.jp (same AEM backend, shared Adobe Experience Cloud / adobe_mc cross-domain ID sync). Data below is taken from the diners.co.jp page-load snapshots captured before the redirect fired; where a diners URL could not be captured cleanly, the structurally identical sumitclub equivalent was observed and confirms the same template/component patterns. Console errors from ad/tracking scripts were ignored as instructed.

globalBlocks.header: Experience Fragment: logo + utility links (merchant, SEARCH, application, Club Online, corporate) + primary global nav (cardlineup, benefit/service, campaign/event, point, insurance, usage, contact, corporate). SEARCH opens search.diners.co.jp.
globalBlocks.localSubNav: Per-section secondary nav bar under header (e.g. magazine category tabs, press/event child links, cardlineup anchor menu). Maps to CCM027_2ndLevelMenu.
globalBlocks.breadcrumb: Present on nearly all pages (CCM013_Breadcrumb). Home > 個人のお客様 > section > page.
globalBlocks.footer: Experience Fragment: PAGETOP, FAQ teaser (Helpfeel external), application/Club Online CTAs, legal link lists, social icons (Twitter/Facebook/Instagram/YouTube), partner logos, copyright.
